text:
Marta R.: Hey team — kicking off Pelmor onboarding. Goal: pilot live in ~6 weeks (customer wants in-store assistant POC). Quick sync: confirm stakeholders, owners, success criteria, and blocker list.

Jason K.: I can own infra + API integration. Need access to their AWS account and sample dataset.

Lee Chen: I'll handle prompt tuning + evals. Can we get product use-cases and 10 sample queries from Pelmor?

Sana Iqbal: I'll do enablement and playbook docs; also responsible for first-week enablement sessions with their CS and product.

Marta R.: Great. Stakeholders we've met: 
- Pelmor: Sam (product), Aisha (ops), Marco (security)
- Our side: Marta (CS), Jason (Infra), Lee (ML), Sana (Enablement)

Jason K.: Requesting Pelmor IAM role or cross-account S3 read access. @Sam can you share role ARN or upload sample export to a presigned S3 link? :slightly_smiling_face:

Pelmor (Sam via email): sharing S3 link by EOD. Also flagged PCI concerns for cardholder flows.

Marta R.: Noted PCI flag. @Marco from Pelmor wants on a call w/ security next Tue. We should prep a short threat model + data flow diagram.

Lee Chen: For evals, propose success criteria draft: 
1) Latency: p95 < 800ms for typical queries
2) Accuracy: top-1 intent match >= 88% on sample set
3) Safety: zero acceptance of disallowed PHI tokens in responses
4) Integration: test harness returns valid JSON schema in 90% of calls

Sana Iqbal: Timeline suggestion (rough):
- Week 0: access + infra setup (Jason)
- Week 1: baseline prompts + shared eval set (Lee)
- Week 2: enablement sessions + docs (Sana)
- Week 3-4: iterative tuning + pilot prep (all)
- Week 5-6: pilot go-live and monitoring handoff

Marta R.: Owners + immediate next actions: 
- Jason: AWS role + endpoint by Fri (owner)
- Lee: draft eval set + baseline prompts by next Wed
- Sana: schedule 2x 60m enablement sessions (week 1) and create runbook
- Marta: coordinate security sync and weekly check-ins

Jason K.: Quick infra note — we'll spin up a dedicated test pool with 2 GPUs and a staging VPC. Sharing cost estimate in a follow-up.

OnboardBot: Reminder created: "Pelmor security sync" scheduled for 2024-04-09 15:00 UTC. Link: https://meet.redwood.ai/meet/abcd1234

Marta R.: Any blockers? If Pelmor can't provide S3 or data due to PCI, we may need synthetic data for initial evals — Lee can own synthetic generation.

Lee Chen: I can synth 500 anonymized queries by Tue. Will aim for 3 categories: store search, returns, receipts parsing.

Sana Iqbal: I'll send a short customer-facing agenda for the enablement call by EOD.

Jason K.: I'll post the temporary endpoint URL when ready and drop a small cURL snippet for tests:

```
curl -X POST https://staging.redwood/api/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED' -d '{"input":"find nearest store with size M"}'
```

Marta R.: Perfect. Let's reconvene Fri 10am PT to confirm infra + sample data. Thanks everyone :raised_hands:

OnboardBot: Thread summary saved to #cs-playbooks (Pelmor onboarding).
